route.openshift.io/termination: edge
  {{- if .Values.keycloak.hostname }}
  hostname:
    hostname: {{ if contains "://" .Values.keycloak.hostname }}{{ .Values.keycloak.hostname | quote }}{{ else }}{{ printf "https://%s" .Values.keycloak.hostname | quote }}{{ end }}
  {{- end }}
  proxy:
    headers: xforwarded
  {{- if .Values.keycloak.waitForDatabase }}
  # The Keycloak operator otherwise starts Keycloak as soon as the Service
  # exists.  A freshly provisioned PostgreSQL pod may still be initializing,
  # which makes Keycloak exit before it can create its schema.
  unsupported:
    podTemplate:
      spec:
        initContainers:
          - name: wait-for-postgres
            image: {{ .Values.postgres.image }}
            command:
              - /bin/sh
              - -ec
              - |
                until pg_isready -h keycloak-db -p 5432 -U "$POSTGRESQL_USER" -d "$POSTGRESQL_DATABASE"; do
                  echo "waiting for Keycloak PostgreSQL"
                  sleep 2
                done
            env:
              - name: POSTGRESQL_USER
                valueFrom:
                  secretKeyRef:
                    name: keycloak-db-secret
                    key: username
              - name: POSTGRESQL_DATABASE
                value: {{ .Values.postgres.database | quote }}
  {{- end }}
{{- end }}
